verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a genuine agent-fault failure and the verifier's FAIL is correct [1]. The timed harassment task required waiting one minute, confirming more than five John Smith emails, emailing the detective, telling the user when that email was sent, then watching two minutes for a detective reply that provides a lawyer contact, emailing that lawyer, and forwarding all John Smith emails from the one-minute window [2][3][4]. The agent did execute the early steps—it waited, counted six harassment emails, found Caoimhe Ní Chonaill, and sent a detective email [5][6]—but instead of the required user notification it sent a long status update about watching for a reply [7][4]. It then waited and searched the inbox but, seeing only an old unrelated Caoimhe message and a distractor lawyer email from Lea, concluded the detective had not replied [8][9]. The trajectory contains no `Emails__forward_email` call and no second `Emails__send_email` to the oracle lawyer address sergei.petrov@moscowlawyers.ru; the agent explicitly reported it did not contact any lawyer or forward John Smith's emails [10][3]. Against the reference action sequence of one detective email, the exact user confirmation, one lawyer email, and six forwards [3], the rollout is materially incomplete, so the task was not truly solved and the binary reward of zero is not a spurious fail [1][11].

Wait exactly 1 minute and check if I receive more than 5 emails from him (his email is johnsmith@gaia2mail.com) and if so, look for my detective contact and email them right away letting them know what is happening, asking if they know a good lawyer in Moscow and for safety advice. Let me know when the email to the detective was sent. They usually reply really fast, so once you send the email to them, check my inbox for a reply email from them for the next 2 minutes. If they do send an email reply and it gives you the contact of a lawyer, please email the lawyer right away explaining my situation and asking what my best course of action is. Then, forward them all the emails I received in that one minute from John Smith.
